Bill-conditioned forecasting, measured.

A one-day pre-registered audit of bill-conditioned forecasting: nine enacted policy events, first-print ground truth frozen before any model ran, ~7,000 scored runs varying model, reasoning effort, elicitation, and which part of the bill the forecaster sees.

PolicyEngine × Thesis Institute hackathon · every design committed to git before its first model call

9 events · ~7,000 scored runs · 36 out-of-sample units + 12 corpus-A units + 14 tool-verified household cases · 8 bill types · 100% of pre-registered designs committed before their first run (initial registration 09:59 EDT; exploratory probes labeled as such)
§1 Recall · §2 Accuracy · §3 Calibration · §4 Envelope · §5 Two legs · §6 Dispersion & tools · §7 Pipeline · §8 Forward · Notes
TL;DR
  • Forecasts track a statute's own numbers only where there is no realized outcome to remember: dose-response flat on a memorized 2021 target, monotone in 6/6 cells on the same statute moved to 2026. Directing the model to derive step-by-step restores tracking on the memorized period; maximum reasoning effort does not.
  • One configuration validates out of sample at N=36 across 8 bill types: frontier model, bill text included, maximum reasoning effort; −0.094 [−0.174, −0.022] vs its naive setup, −0.518 [−0.863, −0.228] vs persistence. The identical recipe at default effort is among the worst arms; bill context pays only with reasoning budget behind it.
  • At default effort, bill text narrowed intervals in 12/12 units while coverage fell: added confidence, not added accuracy.
  • The mechanical leg is solved by tooling: PolicyEngine access takes every model tier to 100% on household arithmetic; an incomplete statutory excerpt degrades even tooled runs.
  • The registered S.3596 poverty delta holds in 14/16 harness combinations; both outliers gave the model only the bill's name. Forward per-configuration forecasts are recorded, so these comparisons keep resolving mechanically after today.
§1 · Recall anchoring, tested causally

Forecasts track the statute only where there is nothing to remember.

The standing objection to any backtest is that the model has read the answers. The causal test: take one real statute (the $300/week FPUC unemployment supplement), rewrite the dollar amount to $100 / $300 / $900, and move only the target period. A target inside the training window has a realized trajectory to remember; a 2026 target has none.

Jan 2021 · max reasoning effort0/4 effort levels at max effort opus-5 spends ~4,400 thinking tokens arriving at the same remembered number (240 runs)
Jan 2021 · directed derivation3/3 cells monotone directing the model to derive the number step by step restores dose-tracking on the memorized period
Nov 2026 · nothing to remember6/6 cells monotone spread 2.3–47× repeat noise; the future arm is never scored, the measurand is dose-response

Cells are unit × model × elicitation, 5 repeats per point. Raising the reasoning budget does not break the anchor; changing the elicitation does.

The mechanism also appears without any dollar rewrite. A purpose clause with zero mechanical content, shown alone with the statute named, moved corpus-A forecasts −2.65% (down in 10 of 12 units, two unmoved; sign test on the 10 nonzero units, p=0.002), more than the operative sections themselves (−0.69%). With the name redacted the shift collapses to −0.35% (p=0.29); with “this is the complete bill” asserted, 0.00%; an access-expanding synthetic clause failed to push forecasts up (N=12 units per arm). The effect follows the name: the model prices in what it remembers Pub. L. 118-5 doing. At statute scale, 6/12 corpus-A units returned identical forecasts under 20-year-stricter and 20-year-looser rewrites of the age caps, both displaced from the unmodified statute.

§2 · Held-out accuracy, matched units

One configuration beats its baselines; added scaffolding does not.

Held-out accuracy is scored with the Winkler interval score alongside nCRPS, so no arm wins by trading coverage away. Each arm is compared on matched units against its own naive same-model elicitation.

Cross-type result, pooled N=36 units, 9 events, 8 bill types. Appropriations, business-side tariffs, an administrative sunset, and a retroactive tax parameter join the corpus; ACP program-creation is scored for dose-response only. The pooled persistence margin is flattered by the new units' catastrophic mechanical baselines; that asymmetry is informative rather than artefactual, since statutory staircases are where extrapolation fails and where text-informed forecasting shows its largest margins. New-type arms ran on a second API transport, recorded per run.

Bill context requires reasoning budget: at default effort it biases the forecast, at maximum effort it improves it. §3 is the default-effort half of this interaction.

Arms cover different unit sets (instruction and scaffold arms never ran the 8 hardest new-type units), so cross-configuration readings here are exploratory; the paired matched-unit comparisons in the forest plot above are the authoritative test. Missing combinations were not run.

Where the gains came from: model tier (the dominant dispersion dimension, §6) and reasoning effort, with median-of-k aggregation improving monotonically (0.243 → 0.231 for k=1→5, N=28 units). Instruction styles, debate (§6), and multi-stage scaffolds sit at or below the plain arms on matched units (all n.s.; opus-5 at max effort, n=26–28), and the multi-agent CTC pipeline dropped sonnet-5 from 66% to 50% tool-free (§6). Across every addition tested, the two that changed outcomes were the tool and the restructured elicitation.

§3 · Calibration

At default reasoning effort, bill text narrowed intervals and worsened coverage.

Showing the model the statute did one thing reliably: it tightened the stated intervals while the share of intervals containing the truth fell. The scope clause matters; the interaction with reasoning effort is §2.

Mean 80% interval, corpus-A reference arm · 60 runs per level
bill text /
first print

Widths and coverage are measured: no-text arm 309k persons at coverage 0.50; the shown-text arms pool to 0.33 (the operative-text arm alone is 234k at 0.32), against a nominal 0.80. Bill text narrowed the interval in 12/12 units (p=0.0005). The bar's position against the print is schematic; the numbers are not. No bill-context level improved CRPS over the no-text baseline (60 runs per level): all four point estimates worse, every CI spans zero.

Out of sample the same pattern holds at default effort (N=28 units): bill text made fable-5 worse (nCRPS 0.292 → 0.339; coverage 0.66 → 0.61) and bought opus-5 nothing (0.253 → 0.261, coverage flat). The sign flips at maximum effort (§2).

Stated and revealed uncertainty also come apart. Across 728 cells the models' sampled answers spread far less than their stated intervals admit (median revealed/stated ratio 0.26), and the ratio predicts miscalibration (cell-level ρ=0.209, p=1.3e-08; unit-aggregated ρ=0.267, p=0.096; cells share truths, so read the cell-level p with the clustering in mind). Bill text moves the two channels independently: it widens fable-5's sampling spread while its stated width stays flat (p=0.00344 / p=0.45), and narrows opus-5's stated width while its sampling spread stays flat (p=0.00195 / p=0.85).

§4 · Robustness of the recorded number

The recorded delta under sixteen harness configurations.

The dispersion measurement of §6, applied to the morning's recorded S.3596 deltas (registration pending merge): the same conditional forecasts, run again under 4 bill-context conditions × 2 elicitations × 2 models. 16 configurations, medians of 3 repeats per cell (one cell n=2).

Both configurations outside the band are the name-only context: the model shown the bill's name with no text. That is the channel the purpose-clause decomposition isolated (§1, §6). Where actual bill text is present, any of it, the recorded delta holds; where only the name is present, the delta can inflate ten-fold or vanish.

The behavioral-uptake claim is sign-stable in every configuration. Its magnitude varies 4× across harnesses, which is the number the per-config lanes (§8) will score. Values here are the 16-configuration sweep; the reference-config deltas in §8 carry their own labels.

Where bill text is present the recorded delta is robust to the harness; where only the name is present, disclosure of the configuration is the safeguard.

§5 · Both legs, same bill

The two legs land within a factor of two; the large swings are configuration effects.

The team's PR #64 prices S.3596 mechanically on a certified PolicyEngine build. The forecast-leg conditionals, committed the same morning against the lab's already-registered targets (§8), ask frontier models what the published Census series will do if the bill passes.

legchild-poverty Δbasis
mechanical · PolicyEngine microsimulation−0.20pp 17.02% → 16.82% (−1.2% relative) · budgetary impact −$1.83B · gains concentrated at the bottom of the income distribution · PE poverty measure, build P, 2026 static · PR #64, certified build
forecast · conditionals on registered targets−0.10 to −0.15pp opus-5 / fable-5, conditional on enactment, against Census SPM CY2027 · medians of 3 repeats

Compared in the same units, the forecast leg concedes one-half to three-quarters of the mechanical effect, on measures that are not commensurable (PolicyEngine's poverty measure on the build-P population, 2026 static, against the Census SPM child rate realized in 2027), so the levels should not be over-read in either direction. The large swings in this study are configuration effects rather than leg disagreements: hold the models fixed, vary only what they are shown, and the same conditional delta can inflate or vanish on context alone (§4). The mechanical delta is therefore injected from the mechanical leg, never re-derived inside the forecast; the statutory number enters computed, and the forecast leg predicts the series.

The composition of the two legs can only be scored forward. A model that has already priced the policy into its forecast double-counts any mechanical delta composed on top, so no backtest can validate the composition step; it is scored in the forward program (§8), and the configuration ships with the number (§7).

§6 · The dispersion audit, and where tools bind

Scaffolding moves the forecast by multiples of its run-to-run noise.

Corpus A holds one bill and one data vintage fixed: SNAP participation under Pub. L. 118-5 §§311–314, 6 states × 2 target months, forecast from the series as published 2023-06 and scored on first prints (N=2,520 runs, 12 units, 18 configurations, 5 repeats per cell; unparseable responses stay in the denominators). Varying one dimension at a time against a frozen reference: model tier moves the median forecast 9.3% of the unconditioned median, 12.4× its permutation null (dispersion ratio 4.65 [2.11, 6.46]; survives Bonferroni correction and state clustering); elicitation format moves it 8.1%, 4.8× its null (ratio 1.73 [1.17, 2.92], fragile to state clustering, so suggestive); bill context moves it 3.5%, 4.1× its null (ratio 1.81 [1.11, 2.65]), carried by the named purpose clause (§1). Two dimensions are null: the debate pipeline for magnitude (ratio 0.35 [0.10, 0.76], though it shifts forecasts up in 8/9 moving units, p=0.039, and inflates within-cell variance 5.4×), and statutory magnitude itself (ratio 0.97; a 40-year rewrite of the age caps does not move the forecast, which is §1's finding).

§7 · Operational notes

Three changes this suggests for the pipeline.

Each is stated with its adoption point in the team's code; the full write-up, with sizes and what each would have caught, is OPERATIONALISATION.md.

  1. Quantile-native runs should not fall back silently to the interval transform. Scoring transform-rebuilt CDFs instead of the model's own quantiles cost −0.034 [−0.068, −0.003] nCRPS in the matched comparison, and the promotion path at run_thesis_analyst.py:291-299 currently degrades a malformed threshold ladder to the interval transform without failing the run.
  2. A harness-disclosure block on every forecast artifact (model, reasoning effort, elicitation, context level, aggregation, transport), following the artifact-stamp pattern the pipeline already uses twice: transformVersion on every distribution (prediction-distribution.ts:105-108) and the certification block PR #64 stamps on every compute block.
  3. Reform validation should check amendatory completeness, not only parameter existence: validate_reform (policyengine.py:216) accepts a reform built from §2(a) alone, which leaves §24(h)(6) standing and prices the wrong bill (§6). A three-dose elasticity probe (current-law null, statute, off-statute) belongs in the correctness battery (_assert_correctness.py).
§8 · The forward program

Forecasts that cannot be remembered.

Every retrospective accuracy number above sits inside model training windows; §1 is the reason to distrust them, ours included. So the architecture is applied to the team's demo bill and recorded against targets with no realized values: S.3596 conditional forecasts on two already-registered ledger targets with first-print resolution rules, runs committed with timestamps. Chronology is claimed-time from git history, upgraded to the witness-verified tier when the recorder workflow runs on merge (RFC-3161 seal; one command, listed in forward/FORWARD-S3596.md).

irs.soi.ctc.qualifying_children.ty2026
resolves 2028-08-31		 49.3M / 48.5M49.5M / 48.9M+0.2 / +0.3M

Rows show opus-5 / fable-5, medians of 3 repeats. Δ is the median of within-run deltas (fable-CTC per-rep +0.4/+0.3/+0.2), which differs from the difference of the scenario medians shown. The poverty delta is the bill's mechanical channel: refundable dollars reaching families below the current phase-in floor, composed from the PolicyEngine leg. The qualifying-children delta is a behavioral-uptake claim whose mechanical answer is zero, since a phase-in threshold change does not alter qualifying-child status; the models' +0.2–0.3M asserts filing induced by newly positive credits. The two targets separate the operational effect from the inferred behavioral one; if uptake is a fiction, that row gets scored for it.

The harness itself becomes a live experiment: 16 near-resolving program-level targets are selected for per-configuration forecast lanes, with 4 lanes × 3 reps complete on the first four targets and the rest queued. Registration is merge plus recorder seal, pending. §6's dispersion measurement then repeats out of training distribution, under the lab's chronology verification, scored mechanically as targets resolve (first resolutions from August 2026; the S.3596 targets in 2028).

Notes · scope and limits
  1. N. The 12 corpus-A units are 6 states × 2 months of one program under one law and are not independent; the matched-arm evaluation is N=28 units across four events, with a 36-unit cross-type confirmation reported in §2; the corpus-A grid ran at one reference configuration, so its interactions are unmeasured, and the one interaction reported (§2) was measured directly, out of sample; no claim generalizes beyond the programs tested. State N. Always.
  2. Retrospective accuracy is recall-contaminated by construction (§1), ours included: upper bounds, all of it. The forward program (§4, §8) is the uncontaminated version.
  3. Chronology and audit. Every pre-registered design was committed to git before its first run (initial registration 09:59 EDT, f95c4b6c); first prints were frozen before any model ran; an adversarial audit of our own statistics is applied throughout; held-out comparisons quote the pinned canonical batch (CHECK2.md); all instrument defects found during the day were quarantined, corrected, and are documented in the repository.
  4. PolicyEngine is the reference implementation of the statutory arithmetic, a model input, never ground truth for behavior. Every configuration is reported with its repeat variance; one configuration (fable-5 · bill · effort=max) is validated out of sample (§2); statistics were independently re-derived and corrections are documented in the repository.
